name: CSV Reader
description: Reads a delimited text file into a data table. Column names and types can be set explicitly or inferred from the header row.

file.title: Input file
file.description: Absolute path to the CSV file to read.

delimiter.title: Delimiter
delimiter.description: Field separator used by the file; a comma by default.

header.title: Header row
header.description: Whether the first row contains column names.

columns.title: Column schema
columns.description: Optional explicit column names and Arrow types; when omitted the header and type inference define the schema.

name.title: Name
name.description: Column name in the output table.

type.title: Type
type.description: Arrow data type of the column.

emptyStringIsNull.title: Empty string is null
emptyStringIsNull.description: Unquoted empty fields are always NULL; set this to also treat quoted empty strings ("" ) as NULL.
